fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) fell an additional 14% on the day of its 8:1 stock split, adjusting to around $650/share post-split (versus $750 pre-split), with TrendForce's 2027 NAND weakness warning as the primary cause
fields.summary_ko.1: NAND spot prices fell 20% due to reduced SSD orders from Chinese cloud providers, with Q1 2027 prices expected to decline 0–5%, and continued declines forecast from Q2 2027 onward
fields.summary_ko.2: SanDisk's FY2027 supply and two-thirds of FY2028 supply are protected by long-term contracts, but price pressure is expected after contract expiration
